profile.title: South Carolina BHPH dealer
profile.detail: Independent Buy Here Pay Here operator serving deep-subprime and subprime buyers in South Carolina's used-car market.

profile.title: In-house note book
profile.detail: You originate and service your own auto notes - payments, collections and repossessions all run through your back office.

profile.title: Collections carry the whole model
profile.detail: With most buyers deep-subprime, cash flow depends on the speed and consistency of collections, not on the sale itself.

profile.title: Long-duration, capital-heavy paper
profile.detail: Each financed vehicle ties up capital for years while payments trickle back weekly or biweekly.

challenges.title: Slow collections are starving cash flow
challenges.detail: A manual, thin-staffed back office means every extra day-to-collect delays the cash you need to restock - and slow accounts quietly slide toward charge-off.

challenges.title: Repossession and charge-off exposure is high
challenges.detail: BHPH paper is far likelier to sit delinquent or in active repossession than franchise-lender loans - the tail of the book keeps growing and eating margin.

challenges.title: Bank credit is getting tighter and pricier
challenges.detail: After recent high-profile BHPH failures, lenders repriced the segment - floor-plan and credit-line costs are up and advance rates are down.

challenges.title: No market check on South Carolina paper
challenges.detail: One-off offers from a single local buyer give you no way to know the true market price of your book.

industryInsights.fact: BHPH loans run roughly 10% delinquent versus about 3.8% for traditional auto lenders, and are far likelier to be in active repossession.
industryInsights.source: Federal Reserve FEDS Notes, Buy Here Pay Here study, May 2026

industryInsights.fact: Subprime 60+ day auto delinquency hit an all-time high of about 6.65% at the end of 2025.
South Carolina has 130 dedicated state buyers on Debexpert, plus 2,600 nationwide bidders.

solutions.title: Sell the slow tail, keep the payers
solutions.detail: Auction skips, deficiencies and charge-offs to agencies and legal buyers - your team stops chasing paper that no longer pays and works only accounts that do.

solutions.title: Transfer risk while prices hold
solutions.detail: Sell performing paper before delinquency erodes it - recourse and non-recourse structures available.

solutions.title: Liquidity without new debt
solutions.detail: A portfolio sale is not a loan: no covenants, no interest, $0 seller fees, and it funds in about 14 days - years of trickle payments become inventory capital now.

solutions.title: Let the market set the price
solutions.detail: 130 South Carolina-focused buyers plus 2,600 nationwide bidders compete in an open auction - you see every bid.
